BiblicalUsage: To overthrow is the Aramaic word for destroying, and Darius uses it once, in the decree for the temple: God destroy all kings and people that put their hand to alter and destroy this house which is at Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the decree is God's protection written in a king's hand: whoever touches His house will be overthrown, and the empire that signed it did not know it was signing its own warning.
